subject: english
question: Identify the antonym of "Eager":
solution:
The correct answer is: **Indifferent**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Eager"** means being enthusiastic or keen about something; having an intense desire or interest in doing or achieving something. (उत्सुक)
 
 
• **Example:** She was eager to start her new job and make a good impression.
 
 
• The word **"Indifferent"** refers to a lack of interest, enthusiasm, or concern; being apathetic or neutral about something. (उदासीन)
 
 
• **Example:** He was indifferent to the outcome of the match as he didn’t support either team.
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **"Eager"** is **"Indifferent"**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Indifferent**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Keen** (उत्सुक): Having or showing eagerness or enthusiasm.
 
 
• **Example:** He is keen to learn new skills to improve his career prospects.
 
 
 
• **Interested** (रुचि रखने वाला): Showing curiosity or concern about something.
 
 
• **Example:** She is genuinely interested in helping people find solutions to their problems.
 
 
 
• **Enthusiastic** (उत्साही): Showing intense and eager enjoyment, interest, or approval.
 
 
• **Example:** The crowd was enthusiastic when their team scored the winning goal.
 
 

33:Tf6c,

सही उत्तर है: **उदासीन**।
